author: agent-core team
description: Generic SearXNG connector for privacy-respecting metasearch against any SearXNG instance. Read-only, no auth by default. Configure each binding with the base URL of the target instance.

setup.instructions:
Connect Agent Core to a SearXNG instance.

1. Run or choose a SearXNG deployment reachable from Agent Core.
2. Create the binding with base_url set to the SearXNG origin only, for example http://searxng:8080 or https://search.example.com. Each action appends its own path.
3. The instance must allow the JSON output format. In settings.yml set:
   search:
     formats:
       - html
       - json
   Without json in that list, /search?format=json returns HTTP 403.
4. No credential is required. Leave the credential empty and create the binding with config auth_mode set to none if your instance is open. If your instance sits behind a reverse-proxy auth layer, put the required header on the proxy side rather than in this connector.

Agent Core validates outbound URLs. Private, loopback, and Docker-internal hosts may require the Agent Core internal-host allowlist (ALLOWED_INTERNAL_HOSTS) before they can be used as base_url values.

actions.name: healthcheck
actions.description: Check that the configured SearXNG instance is reachable and healthy.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Run a metasearch query and return JSON results. Each entry in results[] carries title, url, content (snippet), engine, engines, category/positions and score when the upstream engine supplies them. Top-level fields include query, number_of_results, answers, infoboxes, suggestions, and unresponsive_engines.

q.description: Search query. SearXNG bang syntax (for example '!images cats') is supported.

categories.description: Comma-separated category list, for example general, images, news, science, it, videos, map, music, files, social+media.

engines.description: Comma-separated engine list to restrict the search to, for example duckduckgo,brave,wikipedia.

language.description: Language or locale code, for example en, en-US, or all.

safesearch.description: Safe search level: 0 off, 1 moderate, 2 strict.

time_range.description: Time filter: day, week, month, or year. Only honored by engines that support it.

page.description: 1-based result page. Sent upstream as pageno.

actions.name: get_config
actions.description: Return the instance configuration, including enabled engines, categories, and default settings. Useful for discovering which engines and categories a binding can use.
